description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types used in a study, with a total of six categories represented. The slices are labeled “Stimuli Type” at the center and include “Draft/Other” (red, approximately 23.7%), “Email” (dark green, approximately 13.2%), “External News Article” (light green, approximately 39.5%), “Interview” (dark purple, approximately 5.3%), “Intra-agency news article” (light gray, approximately 2.6%), and “Press Release” (dark gray, approximately 10.5%). Each slice also includes a fraction indicating the number of instances within that category out of a total of 38. The chart includes a legend displaying the labels and corresponding fractions. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is a visual observation. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices themselves.
